# ErikrafT AI

> ErikrafT AI is an open-source AI image-generation website by ErikrafT, with Portuguese (Brazilian) and English interfaces.

- Website: https://ai.erikraft.com/
- Source code: https://github.com/erikraft/AI
- Privacy policy: https://ai.erikraft.com/privacy.html
- Terms of use: https://ai.erikraft.com/terms.html
- Project documentation: https://github.com/erikraft/AI#readme
- Image-generation model: `aoxo/flux.1dev-abliterated`
- Experimental workflow: image + instructions → AI-assisted prompt interpretation → generated image. The experimental workflow uses `fluffy12222/Qwythos-9B-Claude-Mythos-5-1M-heretic-abliterated` to interpret the reference image and instructions, then uses FLUX to render the result.
- Backend project: https://huggingface.co/spaces/ErikrafT/erikraft-ai
- Languages: Portuguese (Brazil) and English.
- Access and usage are subject to the website's terms, privacy policy, and service availability.

ErikrafT AI is an open-source project. For implementation details, contribution guidance, and technical setup, consult the source repository and its README.
